description:
smash!bang!pow! præsenterer:
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄

♛ Få tidlig adgang til billetsalget ved at forudbestille det nye The Hives album på thehives.com ♛

▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄
The Hives, der de seneste år har spillet fremragende koncerter i Store VEGA og på Copenhell, giver koncert i K.B. Hallen den 18. oktober med sange fra det nye album “The Hives Forever Forever The Hives”, som udkommer d. 29. august.

De svenske garagerock-legender har netop udgivet førstesinglen “Enough Is Enough” fra det kommende album og begiver sig til efteråret ud på en omfattende verdensturné: The Hives Forever Forever The Hives - World Tour 2025.

Skabelsen af dette nyeste vidunder, The Hives Forever Forever The Hives, fandt sted både i Yung Lean/YEAR0001’s og Riksmixningsverket studierne. Sidstnævnte bærer navnet efter ingen ringere end Benny Andersson, det berømte medlem af mægtige ABBA, og ligger i Stockholm. Under vejledning af deres langvarige samarbejdspartner, Pelle Gunnerfeldt, hvis arbejde med Viagra Boys, Yung Lean og Elvira er kendt vidt og bredt. Desuden deltog en meget fornem gæst, Mike D fra legendariske Beastie Boys, der krydsede havene for at være med til at skabe dette magnum opus, og han tog desuden bandet med til sit studie ved de solrige kyster af Malibu. Den anerkendte Josh Homme fra Queens of the Stone Age gav også sin rådgivning under albummets tilblivelse.

The Hives, bestående af Howlin’ Pelle, Chris Dangerous, The Johan And Only, Nicholaus Arson og Vigilante Carlstroem, har gennem mere end tredive år mejslet deres navn ind i rockens historie. Deres bedrifter har ført dem til udsolgte stadioner, og de har delt scene med monumentale bands som AC/DC og The Rolling Stones. BBC har erklæret dem for “en naturkraft,” og Rolling Stone kaldte deres album “Veni Vidi Vicious” for et af årtiets Top 100 Albums. Desuden opnåede deres hymne “Hate To Say I Told You So” en ærefuld plads blandt Pitchforks Top 500 Songs of the 2000s. Med millioner af solgte album og anerkendelse i form af platin-certificeringer og adskillige priser – Grammys, MTV Awards, NME Awards – står de som titaner i musikkens verden. Ifølge den legendariske Joe Strummer er det The Hives, der reddede Rock ‘n’ Roll.

The Hives udgav i 2023 deres sjette studiealbum ”The Death of Randy Fitzsimmons”, der demonstrerede, at bandet som albumkunstner stadig er i topform. GAFFA gav således albummet hele 5 stjerner under overskriften: ”Lige det, rock'n'roll handler om”.

Senest kunne gruppens danske fans opleve forsangerkraftværket Howlin’ Pelle Almqvist og hans altid skarpt klædte medmusikanter på Copenhell 2024, hvor de spillede på festivalens største scene Helviti. Også her var der anmelderroser i luften fra GAFFA, som kvitterede med fire store stjerner til et band, som anmelderen ”til enhver tid gerne vil hyre til min næste store fest”.

Selvom det er 25 år siden, at The Hives brød igennem med albummet ”Veni Vidi Vicious” og den ikoniske single ”Hate to Say I Told You So”, er de svenske garagerockfræsere altså fortsat ’alive and kicking’. Derfor er der lagt i ovnen til en sveddryppende intens rockkoncert, når The Hives den 18. oktober indtager K.B. Hallens ikoniske arena.

name: Enjoy the Silence
description:
Lørdag 18. oktober 2025 er der sort tøj og synthesizere på plakaten, når Depeche Mode jam-bandet Enjoy The Silence spiller i Kulturhuset Islands Brygge.

Enjoy The Silence spiller den samme musik som Depeche Mode, 80‘ernes største synthesizer-band. Kodeordet er jamband. Enjoy The Silence låner Depeche Modes Sange og forvandler dem til live-oplevelser.

Når kun det næstbedste er godt nok

Bandet spiller Depeche Mode sange, men gør sig ingen illusioner: - "Vi er ikke en præcis kopi af dem, og kan selvfølgelig ikke erstatte dem. Det er som at erstatte dit livs kærlighed med et godt one night stand. Det ene er den ægte vare, det andet er skæg og ballade. Men hvis man kan lide Depeche Mode, tilbyder vi det næstbedste: En god aften i selskab med nogle fantastiske sange, og et udtryk der ligger meget tæt på originalernes", fortæller bandets kapelmester Henning Vincent.


Et show til fødderne og ørerne

Til koncerten kan man opleve højdepunkterne fra hele Depeche Modes karriere – fra starten af 80’ere til det nye årtusinde, fra Just Can ́t Get Enough til Personal Jesus. Der er både plads til at danse sig gennem aftenen og til at lukke øjnene og lytte sig væk.

Enjoy The Silence består af fem musikere og en sampler. Originalt er der ellers kun tre personer i Depeche Mode. Men Enjoy The Silence indspiller ikke plader. De spiller kun koncerter. Derfor har coverbandet udvidet holdopstillingen - hvad originalerne da også selv gør, når de spiller koncerter. Det skal lyde live, og den lyd lever Enjoy The Silence op til.

Praktisk info

Lørdag den 18. oktober 2025
Koncerten er med unummererede ståpladser
Dørene åbner kl. 19.15
Forsalg: 225 kr. + gebyr / Køb i døren: 275 kr.

name: Cevil
description:
Behind the stage name CEVIL is the 24-year-old singer, songwriter and producer Cecilie Vahle. Cecilie has been writing songs since childhood and spent countless hours in the rehearsal room in the attic of her parents' barn in Djursland, absorbed by the many facets of music. Since 2022, Cecilie has lived in Copenhagen and worked purposefully on her music in collaboration with her manager Birk Storm (PRISMA, Laura Ziani, Nicklas Sahl, etc.).

With her uncompromising pop music, with a touch of retro and hyperpop, CEVIL draws inspiration from many different corners of the music world. From St. Vincent to HAIM and Caroline Polachek, CEVIL's sources of inspiration revolve around the anti-fabricated sound that oozes integrity: an integrity that clearly shines through CEVIL's own catalog.

In the fall of 2023, CEVIL made her single debut with “Don’t Speak” followed by a handful of versatile singles – including “20 BPM”, which premiered at Soundvenue and P3, and was featured in Politiken with the words; “Danish pop music always needs more oddballs. More originals, more crazy guys, more unruly punks who draw a little outside the lines. And when you feel like that, it’s hard not to fall head over heels for Cevil’s new single (…)”.

name: HEATHE | Musikcaféen
description:
Based on dissonance and endless repetition, the group conjures up massive and overwhelming sonic walls of reverb-heavy and metallic-sounding noise collages, where desperation, high-frequency ecstasy, and aggressive bursts of energy echo through an infinite darkness.

On stage, the group unfolds as a six-member orchestra, where strings, brass, guitars, electronic percussion, and homemade percussion paint trance-inducing, massive, and breathtaking soundscapes where eternity and the present melt together in an exhausting and almost ceremonial experience.

Since 2016, the Aalborg-rooted band has left audiences in ecstatic awe with overwhelming live performances and sonically elusive releases. In 2025, they return with their second full-length album, Control Your Heart's Desire for Freedom (Empty Tape), an unrelenting maelstrom of aggressive polyrhythms, cacophonous noise rock, and chanting mantras heralding the end of the world.

HEATHE is: Andreas Westmark (Get Your Gun, Hjalte Ross) Filip Dybjerg (The New Family, Narcosatanicos), Jonas Orlowitz (Fräzer) Oskar Krusell (Kogekunst, Hjalte Ross) Simon Mariegaard (Kogekunst, Svaneborg/Kardyb, Calum Builder) Martin Jensen.

name: Avatar Live In Concert
description:
AVATAR: LIVE IN CONCERT 

Eksklusiv Danmarkspremiere: Den 19. oktober 2025 byder K.B. Hallen på en spektakulær oplevelse, når "Avatar: Live in Concert" bringer James Camerons banebrydende mesterværk til live som aldrig før. Denne enestående oplevelse kombinerer James Camerons originale mesterværk i fuld format med et imponerende symfoniorkester og kor, der fremfører filmens prisbelønnede musik live i realtid. Med hele 120 musikere på scenen bliver Pandora og dens magiske verden bragt til live som aldrig før.

Den originale film vises i sin fulde længde på et kæmpestort lærred, mens Stockholm Concert Orchestra leverer den intense og smukke musik, der gjorde Avatar til en uforglemmelig oplevelse.

﻿ ﻿24-year-old Astrid Schick bridges generations and brings women back to the forefront of pop rock. With a flair for big choruses, she delivers insistent, melodic songs reminiscent of Alanis Morissette and Avril Lavigne in the 2000s.﻿

Her debut EP, "Skal Det Leves Ihjel", was released in June 2025 and received 5 stars in GAFFA, which called Astrid Schick “an extremely promising pop-rock talent.” Both the first single, Mig og Min Veninde, and the focus track, Kysser Med Andre, were selected as Hit Tip of the Week on P4.﻿

In May, she played at the SPOT Festival, and in August she performed at this year's Live Camp at Smukfest. Astrid Schick comes from the music community SheCanPlay, which in recent years has produced several of the most exciting female artists.

name: CopenOpen Poetry Slam
description:
CopenOpen is an open poetry slam that you can attend as a guest or slammer every third Friday of the month. It costs DKK 50 to see the performers, and tickets can be purchased at the door.

If you want to participate as a slammer, please note the following:

  • You can ONLY register for the next poetry slam. You do this by sending a private message to CopenOpen on our Facebook page from the 1st of each month. Places are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
    The rules for the slam are:
  • Ten slammers in the first round and six in the second round. Points from the two rounds are added together, and the three with the most points go to the final, where the points are reset.
  • You must have written your own text.
  • You may not use costumes, props, or musical instruments.
  • The audience awards points between 0 and 10. The slammers may not know the judges.
  • If you perform for more than 3 minutes and 10 seconds, you will be given a time penalty: ½ point for every 10 seconds or part thereof.
  • Freestylers get an extra minute to collect words from the audience (this must be reported to the host before the show starts).
  • All participants get two beer tickets.
  • The order is drawn by lot before the show starts. Therefore, slammers must be present 15 minutes before the show starts.

And remember - the point is not the points, the point is the poetry.

(NOTE: The primary language of the event is Danish).

name: Community in Otherness - TALKS & MOVIES - ***FREE*** CPH Zine Fest 2025
description:
This day we'll celebrate Otherness, Community and all things DIY. Explore art and listen to artists story about not fitting in. 


-PROGRAM-
ALL DAY: Exhibition and zine stalls in VOX

15.00 Cinema Cafe and VOX opens 
16:00-16.30 Story by small-press publisher Zarina from Træsh Forlag. 
17:00-17.45 Talk with artist and activist Erica Engdahl & Wil from the queer bookstore 'The Pond'. Moderated by Karina Wilsøe Stenby.
17.45-18.30 Break - Small exhibit in VOX and zinestalls
18.30-19.30 4 Shortfilms from Plastic Collective with short introductions by the directors.
19.45-21.05 Documentary 'Monster Road'
21.30 Cinema Cafe closes 

______________________________________________________
PLASTIC Collective presents: 
A curated screening by PLASTIC Collective, an experimental art collective based in Viborg exploring new forms of animation and storytelling.From poetic reflections on transformation in Ameoba (Pernille Kjaer), to darkly humorous reflections on society in The Right to Be Forgotten (Tue Sanggaard), bittersweet minimalism in But Jane Was Deaf (Tobias Rud), and experimental explorations of cinematic form in A Visualization of a Cut (Claudia Munksgaard Palmqvist) – each film challenges perceptions of identity, society, and human connection.
______________________________________________________
'MONSTER ROAD' (80mins, 2004):
A documentary that explores the wildly fantastic worlds of legendary underground clay animator Bruce Bickford. Tracing the origins of his remarkably unique sensibility, the film journeys back to Bickford's childhood. Bickford's films, especially the dark and magical clay animations he created for Frank Zappa in the 1970s, have achieved cult status worldwide. Entirely self-taught, the 56-year-old Bickford works alone in a makeshift basement studio in his house near Seattle. The movie reveals the wonder of creation and Georges pain of living a life disengaged from his family and centered on the imperfections in those around him.

name: Cult Pump Workshops - CPH Zine Fest 2025
description:
Don't miss out on the legendary workshops in the art space Cult Pump. They will open up their speciel place to teach you zine culture and great techniques.


Zines the oldschool way with professor Zven Balslev:

Drawing workshop resulting in a zine in the very old-fashioned analog way, with the cherry on top: black and white photocopy with screen-printed cover. Drawing, collage, copy warp, typewriter, everything is allowed except your computer. 


Monotype and zines in one copy with professor Oliver Maarup Jørgensen:

A workshop where we focus on the graphic technique monotype - a printing form where you paint with ink on a plate, and then print the motif onto paper. On the plate there will be a faint outline of the motif you have just printed. By reusing the previous motif and adding or removing elements, you can now create a series of prints that have a sequence that ties them together. The prints you make will be collected in a unique zine.

SIGN UP for one of the workshops by writing an email to: cultpump@mail.com

name: Adam Seuba - Intim Koncert Amager Records
description:
Adam har de seneste år skrevet flere internationale Top 10-hits for artister verden over og er nu i gang med at etablere sig som soloartist med et organisk og melodisk projekt i krydsfeltet mellem indie, folk og pop.

I forbindelse med udgivelsen af hans debut-EP til efteråret, tager han nu på tour med et nyt og unikt duo-setup. Sammen med en guitarist/keyboardspiller skaber han en energisk og stemningsfuld oplevelse med synths, trommemaskiner og real-time vokaleffekter. Det er både intimt, visuelt og innovativt.

Adam Seuba er en kunstner, sangskriver og producer født i København, der skaber en dristig og original poplyd med rødder i eksperimentel folk-pop og rå, ærlig historiefortælling.
Efter årevis med at skrive og producere for store internationale
navne genlancerede Adam sit soloprojekt i 2023. 

Adam er kendt for sine følelsesladede optrædener og genre-trodsende produktion, og hans kommende debut-EP introducerer en helt ny lyd i popscenen. Hans liveshow – formet
af et helt liv med optrædener siden han var 9 år – er en stærk oplevelse der giver dyb genklang, uanset om du kender musikken eller ej.

Han har udsolgt sine hovednavne i København og delt
scener med kunstnere som Drew Sycamore og D-A-D, med flere
koncerter på vej i 2025. Udover sit kunstnerarbejde fortsætter Adam med at trives som multiplatin sangskriver og producer med numre for P1 Harmony (Pretty Boy, et fremragende nummer på deres #1 Billboard World Album), SUPER JUNIOR, Laura White, Theresa Rex, MORTEN og flere. Han er signet med Deekay Music og BMG US for udgivelse.

Med et karakteristisk sonisk univers og et livekoncept født af et
liv i musikken er Adam Seuba hurtigt ved at blive et af de
mest spændende navne i den nye bølge af pop.

name: Cph Listening Room Feat: Patrick Quarterman
description:
Patrick is a 'Third Culture Kid' who grew up in China to a German-Filipino household, and now calls Denmark home. His music journey took the shape of a 2000s kid who got into the acoustic guitar because of Jack Johnson, John Mayer and Jason Mraz. Patrick embraces his lyrically playful yet sensitive side as a songwriter. He loves to decorate his tunes with earworms, jazz harmonies and groovy rhythms.
